title: The mass hierarchy
caption: Fermion masses span from the electron (0.511 MeV) to the top quark (173 GeV): 5.5 orders of magnitude, and the neutrinos are lighter still (below 1 eV, so at least 5.7 orders below the electron). No one knows why.
alt: A logarithmic mass scale in eV from 10 to the 0 up to 10 to the 12, with neutrinos below 1 eV, the electron at 0.511 MeV and the top quark at 173 GeV.
description: Top quark: 173 GeV = 1.73 × 10¹¹ eV, 5.5 orders above the electron.

claims.name: top is about 3.4 × 10⁵ times the electron
